result.protein ingredients: Hydrolyzed proteins, keratin, collagen, silk and amino acids temporarily fill gaps in the strand. Too much leaves hair stiff, brittle or straw-like; too little can leave it stretchy and mushy.
result.lightweight moisturizers for curly hair: No note for this term. Do not make claims about it.
